title: useDispatch
description: Learn how to dispatch actions to the Redux store.

data.text: **useDispatch** returns the store's dispatch function, allowing you to dispatch actions from components.

data.title: useDispatch
Stable Reference
data.text: useDispatch returns a stable reference, so it won't cause unnecessary re-renders.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: useDispatch is how components update Redux state.
